meta.title: DINWEY Vehicle Master Database (PARTIALLY VERIFIED — T1 third-party fitment evidence added)
meta.note: Vehicle identity/market/electrical-system fields are public, verifiable facts. Fitment fields are populated ONLY where T1 independent fitment guides (Club Assist Commercial Fitment Guide, Century Batteries Selection Guide — both Australian commercial-vehicle battery authorities) document a battery group. These are INDUSTRY REFERENCES, NOT DINWEY official OEM confirmations — consumers must still verify against the vehicle spec. Where no T1 evidence exists, fitment fields stay NULL.
meta.fitment_source_note: Battery groups sourced from Club Assist 'Commercial fitment and cross-reference guide' (clubassist.com.au) and Century Batteries 'Selection Guide' (centurybatteries.com.au). Both are independent T1 commercial-vehicle fitment references. JIS group names (N150/N200/N120) map to DINWEY native JIS models; DIN group codes (e.g. 60038) are DINWEY's own model codes matched by dimensions. | 2026-09-08 nightly: Fuso/MB/DAF/Iveco/UD fitment added from Club Assist Commercial Fitment Guide (T1).

vehicles.compatibility_note: Battery configuration depends on vehicle generation and spec. Verify against vehicle specification before replacement.

vehicles.fitment_evidence: Club Assist Commercial Fitment Guide: Hino 700 Series FS/FY/SH/SS 2004-2016 = N150 (MF150/SN150/HCC150); Century Batteries Selection Guide: Hino 700 Series = N150.
vehicles.compatibility_note: N150 group confirmed by two independent T1 fitment guides. 24V system uses 2x12V in series. Verify terminal orientation and tray before replacement.
vehicles.source: Club Assist Commercial Fitment Guide + Century Batteries Selection Guide

vehicles.dinwey_recommendation: DINWEY 暂无可直接对应的 N100 型号 — 需向 DINWEY 询价/确认替代型号
vehicles.fitment_evidence: Club Assist Commercial Fitment Guide: Isuzu FRR600 (Sitec III) 2009-on, FSD 120-260/140-260 current, FSR 120-260 current = N100L (SN100L/N100CMF/HCC100L-XHD).
vehicles.compatibility_note: Isuzu F 系列普遍使用 JIS N100L 组（非 N150/N200）。DINWEY 当前产品线无 N100 型号，需确认是否可按需定制或提供替代。24V 系统 = 2x12V 串联。

vehicles.battery_group: N150 (heavy FV/FP/FS class) — light/medium Fighter FK/FM/FN use 55D23R/80D26R
vehicles.dinwey_recommendation: 145G51 (N150) for heavy Fighter FP/FS/FV variants; light/medium Fighter FK/FM/FN 暂无对应 (需询价)
vehicles.fitment_evidence: Club Assist: Fuso FP/FS/FV Series = N150 (SN150x2/HCC150). Fuso Fighter FK1024/FK1424/FM1627/FN2427 = 55D23R/80D26R (small light/medium groups). eBay T2: N150 'Fits Mitsubishi Fighter 400HP/FU/FP/FS'.
vehicles.compatibility_note: Fuso Fighter spans light(FK/FM/FN, small 55D23R/80D26R) to heavy(FP/FS/FV, N150) classes. DINWEY 145G51 only matches the heavy N150 variants. Light/medium Fighter groups have no DINWEY match — 需询价.

vehicles.fitment_evidence: Club Assist: Fuso FP/FS/FV Series = N150 (SN150x2/HCC150) — Super Great is the heavy FV/FP/FS class. eBay T2: N150 'Fits Mitsubishi FU/FP/FS' (Super Great/Fuso heavy).
vehicles.compatibility_note: Super Great is the Fuso heavy-truck (FP/FS/FV) range; Club Assist lists these heavy Fuso series as N150 (2x12V series, 24V system). DINWEY 145G51 matches. Verify tray width/terminal orientation.

vehicles.oem_battery: MFN150A (N150) std / MFN200A (N200) H/D / MFN180A BlueTec6
vehicles.fitment_evidence: Club Assist: Actros MP1/MP2/MP3 all models 1996-2013 = N150 (MFN150A); Actros 3240/3341/4141 MP4 2014-on = N150 (MFN150A); Actros 2651/2655/2660 & 2643/2646 heavy-duty option 2014-on = N200 (MFN200A); BlueTec 6 2016-on standard = MFN180A.
vehicles.compatibility_note: Actros 24V = 2x12V series. Standard fitment N150 (MFN150A, DIN Euro-spec); heavy-duty option N200 (273mm wide); note BlueTec 6 MFN180A is a DIN 180Ah group DINWEY does not stock. DINWEY 145G51/190H52 are JIS-group matches by dimensions.

vehicles.fitment_evidence: Club Assist: Atego 1224/1229/1623-1629/2324-2329 = N150 (MFN150A); Atego heavy-duty option = N200 (MFN200A).
vehicles.compatibility_note: Atego (distribution) 24V = 2x12V. Standard N150, heavy-duty option N200. DINWEY 145G51/190H52 are JIS-group matches by dimensions to the MFN150A/MFN200A DIN groups.

vehicles.fitment_evidence: Club Assist Volvo Trucks note: most Aust-assembled Volvo trucks to 2013 = 2xN150 behind cabin; European-built = 2xMFN150A (DIN). Volvo FM 2014-on = N200. eBay cross-ref: N150 fits Volvo FH580/FH12/FH16.
vehicles.compatibility_note: Volvo FH 24V = 2x12V 串联。2013 前 N150，2014 后 N200。欧洲原装 = DIN 规格。确认产地/年份/电池长度(335mm vs 500mm)后替换。

vehicles.fitment_evidence: Club Assist: Volvo FM7/FM9/FM10/FM12 1998-2013 = N150 (2x N150); Volvo FM 410/540 2014-on = N200; Volvo FMX 11/13 2010-on = N200. Note: most Aust-assembled = N150, European-built = MFN150A Euro/DIN spec.
vehicles.compatibility_note: Volvo FM 卡车 24V = 2x12V 串联。2013 前用 N150，2014 后升级 N200，FMX 用 N200。欧洲原装车用 DIN 规格(MFN150A)。需按产地/年份确认。

vehicles.fitment_evidence: RDP/Club Assist fitment guide: Scania R420/R480/R500/R560/R580 2005-2014 = N150; Scania R490/R500/R580/R620/R730 Euro VI 2015-on = N200 (276mm width). Scania R113/R143 1987-1997 = N150.
vehicles.compatibility_note: Scania 24V = 2x12V 串联。2005-2014 用 N150，2015-on Euro VI 升级 N200(276mm 宽)。老款 2/3/4 系列也用 N150/N120。需按年份确认宽度。
vehicles.source: RDP Battery Fitment Guide (truckpartsuperstore.com.au) + Club Assist

vehicles.fitment_evidence: Club Assist Commercial Fitment Guide: MAN TGS Series 2007-on = N150L (standard 222mm), N200 (H/D option 273mm).
vehicles.compatibility_note: Battery width is the determining factor: standard option = 222mm (N150), heavy-duty option = 273mm (N200). Verify battery tray width before replacement.

vehicles.battery_standard: JIS (EU market supplied in JIS N-group)
vehicles.fitment_evidence: Club Assist Commercial Fitment Guide: MAN TGX Series 2007-2013 = N150L; H/D option (273mm) = N200.
vehicles.compatibility_note: Battery width determines the group (N150L vs N200). Verify tray width and terminal orientation before replacement.
DAF XF 24V = 2x12V. XF95/XF105 standard = N150 (MFN150A DIN); XF105 FAD 8x4 rigid 2013-on = N200. DINWEY 145G51/190H52 are JIS-group matches by dimensions to DIN groups.

vehicles.battery_group: N150 (MFN150A) ATi/460 2002-2013 / N200 (MFN200A) E5 2014-on / HCC27SC (smaller D31 class) AD/AS-L/AT variants
vehicles.dinwey_recommendation: 145G51 (N150) ATi 360/450 & Stralis 460 2002-2013; 190H52 (N200) E5 2014-on; AD/AS-L/AT variants 暂无对应 (需询价)
vehicles.fitment_evidence: Club Assist: Stralis ATi 360/450 2002-2013 = N150 (MFN150A); ATi 360/450 E5 2014-on = N200 (MFN200A); Stralis 460 2002-2013 = N150; Stralis 460 EEV 2014-on = N200; Stralis AD 505/AS-L/AT (2002-on) = HCC27SC (S95D31RHD/27H-750, smaller group).
vehicles.compatibility_note: Stralis 24V = 2x12V. ATi/460 line = N150 (2002-13) -> N200 (2014-on E5). AD/AS-L/AT variants use smaller HCC27SC (95D31/D31) group — no DINWEY match, 需询价.

vehicles.fitment_evidence: Club Assist: U.D. CK17-380/CW26-380/CWA310/CW385/CW445/GK17-420/GW26-420 = N150 (MF150/HCC150). Battery Brands Warehouse (T2): N150 listed as common fitment for 'UD Quon'. Quon is the U.D. heavy CW/GK/GW class.
vehicles.compatibility_note: Quon is U.D. Trucks' heavy range (CW/GK/GW series); Club Assist lists these U.D. heavy models as N150. 24V = 2x12V. DINWEY 145G51 matches. Verify tray before replacement.
vehicles.source: Club Assist Commercial Fitment Guide (clubassist.com.au) + Battery Brands Warehouse (T2)
